summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of AppleBase 3D landing (Vite+React TS). All 10 requested features validated on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). WebGL canvas renders (1920x1080), all 4 sections + footer present, theme toggle persists via localStorage 'applebase-theme', Lenis scroll updates scroll-progress-bar (scaleX ~0.317 at y=1500), product filters (hot=5, available=6, recommended=5, all=9), search narrows to 2 for 'watch' and shows no-results-message for 'zzzz', cart add/remove flow works incl. count badge, total $2,399, empty-message, checkout disabled when empty, toasts for trade-in and express checkout, nav anchors scroll to correct sections via Lenis (features=1273, showcase=2489, specs=4596). Mobile: 0px horizontal overflow, cart+theme visible, desktop nav links correctly hidden under lg breakpoint.

issues: Non-blocking GL driver perf warning: 'GPU stall due to ReadPixels' (throttled to 3x). Likely due to Three.js/GSAP snapshot; low priority.

critical_code_review_comments: useLenis.ts disables Lenis entirely when prefers-reduced-motion is set - scrollToSection() will fall back to el.scrollIntoView which is acceptable, but window.__lenis will be undefined and any code assuming its presence must guard (it does).
Navbar LINKS has 3 entries (Notebooks/Audio/Wearables) all pointing to same #showcase target; harmless but consider deduping or making them filter shortcuts.

GL 'ReadPixels' warnings suggest a per-frame texture readback in useThreeScene.ts; investigate whether renderer.readRenderTargetPixels or similar is called each frame - can hurt performance on lower-end GPUs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 10 requested flows pass. Note: when clicking nav buttons immediately after window.__lenis.scrollTo(0,{immediate:true}), first click can be swallowed by Lenis state - add ~500ms wait before subsequent clicks. Sonner toasts render at data-sonner-toast root; drawer closes via ESC.
